prompt: A multi-tenant app must guarantee tenants can neither read nor insert other tenants' rows, enforced in the database. Which combination is required?
explanation: FILTER handles reads, BLOCK handles writes; the tenant id is supplied via read-only session context so it can't be spoofed.

options.text: FILTER and BLOCK predicates in a security policy, with tenant id in read-only session context
Dynamic Data Masking on the tenant column
A CHECK constraint on tenant id
